card.name: Bios and agency credits in watershed text
card.fires_on: Mixed positions in biographical lists and agency or program descriptions, such as commas after job titles, 'lead' before 'person', and 'by' before agency names. Common in watershed training and government reports.

modes.label: Job lists in bios
modes.description: Comma after a role in a list of someone's jobs.
modes.example: He has served over the years as a pastor, author<<,>> youth ministry trainer, adjunct college instructor and

modes.label: Agency program credits
modes.description: Words about who led, funded or developed a program, such as 'lead' or 'by'.
modes.example: Mr. Gary Stacey, CDFG, was the<< lead>> person for the interagency efforts managed by

modes.label: Citation endings
modes.description: Period ending a reference title before the report series.
modes.example: Fire ecology of the forest habitat types of central Idaho<<.>> General Technical Report INT-218

card.writes: No clear output effect; it suppresses the word reflection and its forms.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in bios and agency program descriptions, and it makes the word 'reflection' less likely.
